Economic Development Announcements GIS Parcel Maps: Click on Learn More (below) or visit the Equalization department page to search for Osceola County parcels. Passport Applications: For more information on applying for a passport, please click on County Departments (under the Government heading above) and visit the Treasurer's Office page. Copperton Projects Community Listening Sessions October 13, 2026 12-7 p.m. Osceola County Fairgrounds, Community Building The Copperton Projects involve building high speed electric transmission lines. It is a part of a larger effort to enhance Michigan's power grid and meet Michigan's growing energy need. Click on Learn More (below) for Listening Sessions pamphlet. Learn more Announcements Request Certified Records : You may now order Certified/Vital Records online! Visit our County Clerk page for more information, or click on Learn More (below) to order Birth, Marriage, Divorce, Death Certificates and Court Records through Official Records Online. Master Land Use Plan: The 2025 Osceola County Master Land Use Plan is available for review. Click on Learn More (below) to see a copy of the Plan. Flooding Disaster April 10 - 21, 2026: U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster loans are available for those affected by the recent flooding event. Click on Learn More (below) to see a copy of the Fact Sheet. Flood Recovery - Link to Emergency Management Information: Click on Learn More (below) for the link. Learn more Announcements Emergency Home Repair Program: Emergency Home Repair is available for qualifying individuals in Osceola County. Click on Learn More (below) for details. Heartland Materials Management Planning Committee: Click on Learn More (below) for a calendar of meeting dates, times, and locations and to read about the HMMPC. Public Comment Period: Materials Management Plan - deadline October 30, 2026: Click on Learn More (below) to review the draft Materials Management Plan (MMP) and share your feedback through an online survey. Learn more County Calendar full calendar Welcome to Osceola County Located in the west central portion of Michigan's lower peninsula Osceola County is perfectly situated to enjoy rural living with easy access to amenities typically found only in larger communities!
